description: Mina, a home baker, must decide whether to accept a neighbor's barter proposal for a custom birthday cake in exchange for family photography, and finalize the cake, photo, pickup, and comparison terms after hearing from the people at the kitchen-table planning session.

agents.name: Jon
agents.role: Neighbor with Knowledge of Another Offer

shared_context.S1: Mina makes custom birthday cakes informally for people in the neighborhood.
shared_context.S2: Mina has one Saturday-afternoon baking opportunity available this month.
shared_context.S3: Mina has been hoping to get a family portrait session, and Ari does photography as a side business.
shared_context.S4: Mina makes the final call on whether to accept the arrangement and what terms to record.
shared_context.S5: As part of Mina's usual planning routine, she asks Ari and Jon for relevant terms before settling an informal deal.
shared_context.S6: The planning session takes place at Mina's kitchen table, where everyone can review the calendar and write agreed terms in a shared notebook.
shared_context.S7: Mina normally confirms the pickup plan, the exchanged services, and any competing commitments before agreeing to a neighborhood arrangement.

PF1.text: Ari's complete proposal is a two-tier birthday cake serving exactly 40 people, with no cash payment, exchanged for one outdoor family portrait session producing exactly 20 edited digital photographs; Ari can have the cake picked up Saturday at exactly 2:00 p.m.

PF2.text: Jon has been offered a separate cash cake order for exactly $210, but that customer requires Sunday pickup, so it cannot use Mina's available Saturday-afternoon baking opportunity.

decisions.selected_arrangement: string; identify which proposed arrangement is accepted
decisions.cake_servings: integer; record the number of servings promised
decisions.cash_payment: integer; record any cash payment exchanged
decisions.portrait_photos: integer; record the number of edited digital photographs promised
decisions.portrait_session_committed: boolean; indicate whether the photography exchange is committed
decisions.pickup_day: string; record the agreed pickup day
decisions.pickup_time: string; record the agreed pickup time
decisions.alternative_cash_offer: integer; record the cash amount of the alternative cake order
decisions.alternative_pickup_day: string; record the pickup day required by the alternative order

acceptance_conditions: Ari's barter arrangement must be selected and the notebook must contain the exact cake commitment for Ari.
The cake commitment must record the agreed serving quantity and cash amount.
Ari must commit to the agreed photography exchange, including the promised number of edited digital photographs.
The cake commitment must state the agreed pickup day and time.
The separate alternative must be recorded in an exact commitment with its cash amount and required pickup day.
Ari's exact barter proposal must be cited as justification for the selected terms.

content_checks.C2: any(c['type'] == 'cake_barter' and c['target'] == 'Ari' and c['detail'] == '40 servings; $0 cash' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C3: any(c['type'] == 'photography_exchange' and c['target'] == 'Ari' and c['detail'] == 'one outdoor family portrait session; 20 edited digital photographs' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C4: any(c['type'] == 'cake_pickup' and c['target'] == 'Ari' and c['detail'] == 'Saturday at 2:00 p.m.' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'alternative_order' and c['target'] == 'separate customer' and c['detail'] == '$210 cash; Sunday pickup' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and ('PF1' in credited_facts or 'PF1' in revealed)

decisive_facts.why: Ari's exact proposal changes the selected arrangement and the required commitment records to 40 servings with $0 cash, 20 edited photographs, a portrait session, and Saturday pickup at 2:00 p.m.
Jon's information changes the comparison from an unknown alternative to an exact commitment for a $210 cash cake order requiring Sunday pickup.
